animated_woman.explanation: Animated Woman.glb is the Casual character (Casual_Head, _Body, _Legs, _Feet) and Animated Woman-nIItLV9nxS.glb the Formal one (Formad_Head, Formal_Body, _Legs, _Feet): no mesh is shared; they share the skeleton (equal inverse bind matrices) and the 24 animations, as every women's file does. Both are catalogued.

conventions.ids: <slot>_<m|w>_<character> for pack parts; <kind>_<m|w>_<character>[_<descriptor>] for head items (m or w is the source pack, not a restriction: heads, hair and face items cross body types)
conventions.numbers: metres to 4 decimals (_m), millimetres to 1 decimal (_mm)
conventions.space: world metres in the rest pose of the body type's skeleton file; +Z up, the face toward -Y, +X the character's left; every part rebound onto that rest (um/rebind.py), heads onto both rigs

recipe.note: a colour region of the skull: keep Skin_Darker out of as_skin to show it

rules.condition: After um/fit.py tuck_cull, rays at each ankle in the rest pose: see-through and poke-through no higher than the references' (the bottom with its own shoes, the shoes with their own bottom) plus 2. overlap_mm = collar top - bottom lower edge (the lower leg): below -30 mm the bottom is too short (gap); below 0, or too many see-through rays, extend_edge is tried on the bottom's hem. Tucked when most of the shin just under the collar is inside the shoe, else worn over.

verdicts.gap: the bottom ends more than 30 mm above the collar (a knee-length bottom over low shoes) or the fix does not close it
verdicts.needs_fix: a gap of up to 30 mm (or a sliver) that extend_edge on the bottom closes, measured
verdicts.ok_over: worn over the shoe; no see-through and the shoe does not show through
verdicts.ok_tucked: tucked in; after tuck_cull no see-through and no poke-through
verdicts.poke: the shoe and the bottom cross: one shows through the other
verdicts.review: no vertical gap, and the rays fail the allowance by at most 4 rays or 1 % of the rays cast: too close to call by rays; the designer decides on a render

rules.condition: Rays at the waist, at rest and walking: see-through and poke-through no higher than the references' (each part with its own pack partner) plus 2. overlap_mm = bottom upper edge - top lower edge: below 0, or too many see-through rays, extend_edge is tried on the top's hem. The outer part is the one hit first where both are.

verdicts.gap: more than 30 mm apart, or the fix does not close it
verdicts.needs_fix: a gap of up to 30 mm (or a sliver) that extend_edge on the top's hem closes, measured
verdicts.ok_over: the top hangs over the bottom
verdicts.ok_tucked: the top goes inside the bottom
verdicts.poke: the waistband and the hem cross: one shows through the other
verdicts.review: no vertical gap, and the rays fail the allowance by at most 4 rays or 1 % of the rays cast: too close to call by rays; the designer decides on a render

rules.condition: Rays at the neck, at rest and walking: see-through and poke-through no higher than the references' (the head with its own top, the top with its own head) plus 2; too many see-through rays send the pair to extend_edge on the head's neck. overlap_mm (top neck ring top - head bottom) is recorded but is positive for every pair: the rays decide every neck verdict.

verdicts.gap: more than 30 mm apart, or the fix does not close it
verdicts.needs_fix: extend_edge on the head's neck closes it, measured
verdicts.poke: the neck and the collar cross: one shows through the other
verdicts.review: no vertical gap, and the rays fail the allowance by at most 4 rays or 1 % of the rays cast: too close to call by rays; the designer decides on a render

rules.condition: The hair stays inside the hat: on the scalp rays (toward the skull centre) no more hair comes out in front of the hat, or lies on it, than with the hat's own hair (poke and z-fight rays no higher than that reference plus 2). The helmets that are whole heads replace the skull and the hair.

verdicts.needs_fix: fits after the hat is inflated (scaled off the skull by 1 to 3 %), measured
verdicts.ok: the hair stays inside the hat
verdicts.poke: the hair comes out through the hat even with the hat inflated by 3 %
verdicts.review: no vertical gap, and the rays fail the allowance by at most 4 rays or 1 % of the rays cast: too close to call by rays; the designer decides on a render

rules.condition: Hair covers the skull's open top (no hole rays) and the skull surface never comes out through the hair or lies on it (no poke or z-fight rays).

verdicts.gap: the open top of the skull shows (cap-style hair is missing or does not cover it)
verdicts.needs_fix: fits after inflate 0.006 (the hair scaled off the skull), measured
verdicts.poke: the skull cuts through the hair even after the inflate
verdicts.review: no vertical gap, and the rays fail the allowance by at most 4 rays or 1 % of the rays cast: too close to call by rays; the designer decides on a render
